fgmplus.studio.title: Shape Studio
fgmplus.studio.pos_z_tip: Right = protrude forward, left = pull toward the body; overflow beyond the safe envelope is flattened automatically
fgmplus.studio.preview_tip: Preview the custom hurt sound; resources reload only when the files changed
fgmplus.studio.debug_tip: Green translucent panel = the computed torso-back plane; if it hugs the back, the anti-clip clamp is verified
fgmplus.studio.sound_none: No .ogg found (preview plays the vanilla sound)
fgmplus.studio.roundness_tip: 0% = vanilla box shape, 100% = fully round; morphs every pass (skin, jacket, armor) onto a superellipsoid
fgmplus.studio.cleavage_tip: Bridges the inner halves toward the torso centerline at high roundness; OFF restores the plain superellipsoid and FGM's own separation slider feel
